body_text: Our dining hall is a warm, joyful space where children eat together, serve themselves, pour their own water and practise table manners, without mealtimes becoming a struggle.

items.title: Wholesome Platters
items.text: Colourful, balanced meals from breakfast through lunch, so children discover new tastes at their own pace.

items.title: Healthy Habits
items.text: Food-group visuals on the walls help children understand what a growing body needs.
